stageNotes: Stage 1: apex returns 200 with <link rel='canonical' href='https://durhamoutdoors.ca'>. Canonical = apex.

Stage 2: heavy 8-batch probe. CF-RAY header + __cf_bm cookie = Cloudflare. Bot-UA (batch 2c), SQLi-union (batch 6b), XSS (batch 7a), 5 honeypot paths (batch 4b-4f) all -> 403. Rapid burst of 10 requests stayed 200. No active challenge body. Classified as cloudflare-active with iPhone UA override.
Stage 3: Platform = Shift4Shop/3dcart. Strong fingerprints: assets/templates/common-html5/, vcart=26.19.0, _3d_cart JS var, 3dcartGoogleAnalytics template comment, .asp URLs. No age gate, no CAPTCHA.

Stage 4: 9 categories from sitemap.xml + category_index.asp. Walked all 9 (45 page fetches). NON-RESTRICTED is a legal-classification cross-cut with 194/281 overlap with Rifles, 82/281 with Shotgun, but 5 unique products -> kept. RESTRICTED 200/empty -> kept. Extraction quality: 3/3 sample products gave title, price, stockStatus.

Stage 5: Pagination = suffix-replace ({slug}.html -> {slug}-{N}.html). page 1 IDs disjoint from page 2 IDs (0 overlap). perPage=12 verified. ?viewall=1 returns full set in one page but ship 12 for runtime safety.

Stage 6: 3-outcome counter-control. default -> 117,120,121 (oldest-first product_id ASC). sortby=4 -> 3593,3592,3591 (newest-first DESC, monotonic). sortby=3 -> 3504,3506,3490 (alpha, distinct). sortParam = '?sortby=4', sortVerified=true.
Stage 7: navigate-from-watermark. No REST API. product_id is monotonic and serves as sourceId. Use sortby=4 for newest-first walk.

Stage 8: expectedProductCount = 389 (walked union of all 9 categories). productCountMethod = html-pagination (per-category .paging selector x perPage 12) - runtime probe will not exactly reproduce 389 (rounds up to multiples of 12); the canonical truth is the walked union documented in topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck.
Stage 9: validated against profile-validator shape. searchUrl /search.asp?keyword={keyword} discovered from homepage <form action='search.asp'>.
